Lyra Capital.description: The investment arm of Lyra Technologies, with a startup portfolio and founder network.

Y Combinator.description: Startup accelerator and seed investor that runs four batches a year.

Airtree.description: Airtree is an early-stage venture capital firm backing Aussie and Kiwi founders building the iconic technology companies of tomorrow. Fund V closed August 2025 at A$650M.

Square Peg.description: Discover Square Peg, a venture capital firm. Founded in 2012 in Australia, we now back founders early and repeatedly across APAC's fastest-growing technology markets. Fund 6 first closed February 2026 at A$650M.

Side Stage Ventures.description: Side Stage Ventures is a founder-led seed fund backing outlier founders in Australia. We write the first cheque into the best early stage companies. Then we lean in to help the founders build & scale. Fund II first closed at A$40M in 2026; first cheques up to $1.5M.

Startmate.description: Australia and New Zealand's mentor-led accelerator and founder community; runs a 14-week, remote-first Accelerator investing A$120k at a A$1.5M post-money valuation, plus the Launch Club pre-accelerator. 350+ portfolio companies worth a combined $4.5B.

Seedcamp.description: Europe's original first-check investor, backing pre-seed and seed founders since 2007; early backer of Revolut, Wise and UiPath. Fund VII closed Jun 2026 at $220M, alongside a $100M Select fund, taking AUM past $1B.

USV.description: New York venture capital firm investing from the earliest stages and supporting founders across markets. Raised a $900M fund cycle in October 2026.

Madrona.description: Venture capital firm founded in Seattle, investing from seed and early stages through acceleration. Raised $770M across Fund X and Acceleration Fund IV in January 2025.

Kaszek.description: We are tech entrepreneurs partnering with the most extraordinary founders in Latin America.

Wing VC.description: Wing is an early-stage AI-first venture firm investing in companies building the next generation of AI applications, infrastructure, data, and more. Seed to Series A funding.

Pear.description: Pear VC is an early stage venture firm founded in 2013. We partner with founders at the earliest stages to build enduring companies. Fund V announced October 2026 at $333M; PearX accelerator.

Uncork.description: Uncork Capital is a seed-stage venture firm backing exceptional founders from zero, investing early in AI-native companies that are shaping what's next. Uncork VIII ($225M) and Plus IV ($75M) closed May 2025.

Thrive Capital.description: Investment firm building and investing in internet, software and technology-enabled companies. Thrive X closed February 2026 at over $10B, weighted to growth stage.

Boab AI.description: Australia's leading AI adoption partner (Artesian's AI arm) based in Melbourne; $20M+ deployed across its ecosystem; runs pre-accelerator programs for early-stage AI entrepreneurs.

Boson Ventures.description: Boson Ventures invests in early-stage Australian deep-tech and healthcare companies and helps them scale into China.

Cicada Innovations.description: Cicada Innovations is Australia's leading incubator for startups and scaleups working on deep tech science and engineering innovations.

CoLabs Australia.description: Lab, engineering & office space for bio & deep tech startups in Melbourne, Sydney & Brisbane. Build what the world needs faster with our support & community.

HEX.description: Innovation education for the gap year generation. Get ready to lead in an exponential world. Start with HEX. Then choose your future career.

Illume Ventures.description: Runs Future Frontier, a 10-week AI deep-tech pre-accelerator with Monash AI Institute, funded by Innovation Victoria; Cohort 2 runs 9 Apr–18 Jun 2027.

Jumpstart Studio.description: The perfect place to start your first business. At Jumpstart Studio, we mentor professionals to become successful entrepreneurs and first-time founders.

MedTech Actuator.description: Melbourne-based accelerator for medtech, healthtech and biotech startups; runs the six-month, milestone-driven Accelerator Australia programme, plus Origin in Singapore and Global Navigator, helping founders turn health ideas into global impact.

RMIT DiscoveryHUB.description: RMIT Activator’s 20-week DeepTech pre-accelerator helping RMIT-affiliated researchers translate research into deeptech, AI and medtech ventures; launched Nov 2026, with two cohorts over two years.

Henson Venture Partners.description: Venture capital firm that reports joining the Microsoft for Startups Investor Network.

Main Sequence.description: Australia's deep tech venture capital firm. We back founders rebuilding the systems the world depends on: energy, food, health, industry, space and intelligence.

Rampersand.description: Backing the most ambitious founders to come out of ANZ, from day zero, wherever they're building – as they rewrite the world from software to atoms.

Investible.description: Investible is an early-stage venture capital firm backing the visionaries advancing humanity through technology across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond. Also runs a climate technology fund.

Artesian.description: Global alternative asset manager founded in 2004, managing $1.5 billion across venture capital and debt. Pioneers of Venture Capital as a Service.

Brandon Capital.description: Brandon Capital invests in the most promising biomedical opportunities that have the potential to improve the lives of patients.

Entrepreneur First.description: We turn exceptional individuals into funded founders. We back you first, then give you a bridge to Silicon Valley.

Station F.description: The world's biggest startup campus in Paris, home to 1,000+ startups and 30+ programmes.

Antler.description: Antler is the world's most active early-stage investor, backing exceptional founders from inception. Elevate growth fund $285M.

Blackbird Ventures.description: Australia and New Zealand's leading multi-stage venture capital firm, backing founders from first cheque to global scale; first institutional investor in Canva. Fund VI closed Aug 2026 at A$1.05B — the largest VC fundraise in ANZ history — across a portfolio of ~190 companies worth >A$12B.

Partech.description: Paris-headquartered global investment platform investing from seed to growth since 1982, with ~€2.7B under management and offices across Europe, Africa and the US. Its inaugural Impact Fund closed Mar 2026 at €300M to scale European B2B impact-tech companies.

CRV.description: One of the oldest US venture firms, founded 1970, backing seed and Series A founders in enterprise, consumer, dev tools and AI; 750+ companies backed and 80+ IPOs, including DoorDash and Vercel. Fund XX closed Aug 2025 at $750M, dedicated to early-stage rounds.

a16z.description: Silicon Valley venture capital firm (Andreessen Horowitz) founded in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz; stage-agnostic, investing from seed to late stage across consumer, enterprise, bio and health, crypto, fintech and games.

Draper Associates.description: Tim Draper's early-stage venture capital firm, founded 1985 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, backing frontier-technology founders worldwide (about US$2.3B AUM, 400+ companies backed). draper.vc is its website; the crawl candidate 'Draper VC' is this firm, and it anchors the Draper Venture Network.

relationships.note: Anchor member firm of the Draper Venture Network; The Block's mapping of the network lists Draper Associates among its member funds.

Draper Startup House.description: Global network of entrepreneur co-living and coworking houses (15+ locations) plus a pre-seed accelerator in Austin investing up to about US$150k per startup. Founded 2018 in Singapore as Tribe Theory by Vikram Bharati; joined the Draper Venture Network in 2019 and rebranded. HQ Singapore.

relationships.note: Joined the Draper Venture Network in 2019 (as Tribe Theory) and rebranded as Draper Startup House.

Draper B1.description: Seed and early-stage venture capital firm based in Valencia, Spain. Founded 2010 as Bbooster (Spain's first accelerator), joined the Draper Venture Network in 2017 and rebranded to Draper B1 in 2020. Founding partner Enrique Penichet; latest vehicle, Draper B1 Frontier Tech, closed over €20M.

relationships.note: Member fund of the Draper Venture Network since 2017 (joined as Bbooster); The Block's mapping of the network lists Draper B1 among its member funds.

Draper Venture Network.description: Self-governed alliance of 20+ independent venture funds founded by Tim Draper (origins in 1990 as the DFJ Network). Member funds raise and manage their own capital while sharing deal flow, diligence and co-investment across geographies; Draper Associates is the anchor firm.
